reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput issueTitle "gmail-gateway: move to swift-crypto 5.x" (no issueUrl or issueNumber)
reviewContext.userProblem: The owner requires every Swift package in the Riela dependency graph to require and build against apple/swift-crypto 5.x (latest 5.0.3) so Riela can resolve a single 5.x version; gmail-gateway currently requires swift-crypto from 4.5.2 (Package.swift:20).
requiredOutcomes: SHA256 outputs stay byte-for-byte identical (lowercase %02x hex for fingerprint, archive sha256, attachment prefix; base64url for PKCE)
VERSION, gmailGatewayVersion() literal (Sources/GmailGatewayCore/GmailGatewayUtilities.swift:5) and CommandTests.swift:53 expected literal become 0.1.29
swift build, mise run test and mise run lint pass
nonGoals: No fork, vendor, path override, mirror config or removal of google-service-gateway to bypass BLK-1
No pin style changes; gateway-sdk-kit stays exact 0.1.1
No refactor of the #if canImport(CryptoKit) pattern; no removal of the unused import in GmailCredentialResolution.swift; no new crypto helpers
No change to expected digest values; no deleted, skipped or weakened version tests
gmailGatewayVersion() must not read VERSION at runtime; no version-generation scripts
No edits to design-docs/specs/architecture.md, Formula/, dist/, impl-plans/PROGRESS.json or other plan files
No GitHub release, build:homebrew, homebrew:formula or homebrew:tap-formula
constraints: TASK-001 gates on BLK-1: if google-service-gateway main does not declare a swift-crypto 5.x lower bound, stop with no repository edits except the plan Progress Log and report the SHA and exact constraint line
Use swift package update swift-crypto google-service-gateway (plus google-gateway-auth only if its revision must change); never a bare swift package update
Crypto product stays linked only on Linux; macOS keeps compiling against CryptoKit
Commit message has no AI attribution
All command logs go under tmp/swift-crypto-5 with exit codes in the plan Progress Log
designDecisionsAndRationale: Fix BLK-1 upstream and bump only the google-service-gateway revision pin, because revision 4cfef44 declares swift-crypto from 4.5.1 (allows only 4.5.1..<5.0.0) and the issue requires reporting such caps as blockers instead of working around them
google-gateway-auth revision changes only if upstream google-service-gateway pins a different revision, since SwiftPM requires identical revisions for the same package
Version bump follows the bb9ddfb convention of changing both VERSION and the embedded literal; the stale 0.1.26 test literal is corrected to keep embedded value equal to VERSION
intentionalTradeoffs: Linux build (V6) may be unavailable locally; it is logged as a verification gap rather than counted as passing
CommandTests.swift:53 expected literal is edited even though tests are otherwise the oracle, because it is pre-existing stale data and must equal VERSION
supportedEdgeCases: BLK-1 still open: blocked stop with no commit
Upstream google-service-gateway public API changes: fixed only at GmailGatewayCore call sites with behavior unchanged and logged
Digest call site changed in TASK-003: add SHA256("abc") known-answer assertion in the existing feature test file
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Homebrew formula, tap or release publication
